items.text: Iran launched drones at Kuwait and Bahrain on 18 Nov. The [[p:Islamic Republic of Iran Army|Artesh]] claims it hit Patriot systems at [[p:Ali Al Salem Air Base]], which hosts US forces; Kuwait says it intercepted the drones and Bahrain says it repelled several attacks. A US official says US aircraft struck an [[p:Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps|IRGC]] launch site on Qeshm on 17 Nov, and two officials say tit-for-tat strikes are now near-daily. No casualties reported.
items.notes: Iranian claims of hits are unverified; Kuwaiti and Bahraini statements say interceptions. US strike reported by officials, not officially announced.

items.text: The [[p:Israel Defense Forces|Israeli army]] launched what it called a concentrated operation in three areas of central Gaza near the 'yellow line', the first large operation there since the October 2025 ceasefire, closing parts of Salah al-Din Road. The US-backed [[p:Board of Peace]] told the UN Security Council the ceasefire could collapse and faulted both Israel and [[p:Hamas]].
items.thread: Gaza ceasefire and Board of Peace plan
items.notes: Operation details from IDF statement as relayed by Drop Site; Board of Peace warning cross-checked with Just Security digest. Reports of three Palestinians killed on 18 Nov not independently confirmed.
